Q5735.reason: A plaintiff cannot remove the case she filed in state court (only defendants may remove under 28 U.S.C. §1441(a)), so the federal court will remand the entire case, and the judge's hostility is irrelevant.

Q5750.reason: Careful consideration is needed because internet access among people over 65 is low, so relying on internet sources would exclude most of them.
